title: Wooden Glass Texture
description: This project adds wooden boundaries to glass.
body:
# Wooden Glass Texture

![Preview of the Wooden Glass Texture resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cN6AFDIF/images/800eadb34c00b2dcebe1368e9f51169388661f54_350.webp)

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cN6AFDIF/images/029f8bcaeb1b4b3a4174fe8694bd0747c0c7e660_350.webp)

A simple resource pack that gives glass a wooden-themed appearance while keeping the original functionality and transparency. Designed to blend naturally with wooden builds, cabins, villages, and rustic environments without changing gameplay.

## Features
- Wooden-styled glass textures
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Lightweight and easy to use
- Perfect for survival and creative builds

Compatible with the supported Minecraft version(s) specified by the pack.
